en.title: S-G-C (Small Gupta Chain)
en.decryption: Remember the sequence of the first three rulers to avoid confusion between Sri Gupta and Chandragupta.

hi.title: S-G-C (Small Gupta Chain)
hi.decryption: Remember the sequence of the first three rulers to avoid confusion between Sri Gupta and Chandragupta.

fact.en: Do not confuse Sri Gupta with Chandragupta Maurya; they belong to completely different eras.
fact.hi: Do not confuse Sri Gupta with Chandragupta Maurya; they belong to completely different eras.

fact.en: Sri Gupta was a 'Maharaja', not a 'Maharajadhiraja'. This title confirms his status as a subordinate ruler/feudatory.
